source.name: Sposuru Magazine: 【JRFU】ラグビー日本代表スポンサー・パートナー一覧 (JRFU: Japan national rugby team sponsor and partner list)
source.quote: 日本代表選手のユニフォームにも書かれている「リポビタンD」でおなじみの大正製薬株式会社は、2020年からラグビー日本代表トップパートナーを務めている企業
source.note: English: 'Taisho Pharmaceutical, known for Lipovitan D which is also written on the Japan national team players' uniform, has been the Japan team's top partner since 2020.' The JRFU's own announcement of 2020-04-01 (rugby-japan.jp/braveblossoms/topics/50457) created the top-partner tier with Taisho as its first holder, and the live JRFU sponsor page (rugby-japan.jp/sponsor/) still lists 大正製薬 as 日本代表トップパートナー (checked 2026-10-04). The large リポビタンD wordmark with its blue 'D' lockup sits across the centre chest of the official launch photo (JRFU, 2025-06-22, rugby-japan.s3.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/image/article/199394_1000x1092.JPG) and of the current retail product photos (Goldwin Online Store replica RG325788, goldwin.co.jp/ap/item/i/m/RG325788), both checked 2026-10-04.

source.name: Japan Rugby Football Union: 日本代表トップパートナー、オフィシャルパートナー、オフィシャルスポンサー、オフィシャルサポーター決定のお知らせ (Top partner, official partners, official sponsors and official supporters decided)
source.quote: 男子日本代表オフィシャルパートナー 株式会社 東芝 株式会社三井住友銀行
source.note: JRFU announcement naming Toshiba a men's Japan national team official partner from FY2020; Toshiba remains listed as a men's official partner on the live JRFU sponsor page (rugby-japan.jp/sponsor/, checked 2026-10-04), and Toshiba's own brand site confirms it supports the Japan national team (toshiba-clip.com/detail/p=10310, 2023-07-28). The TOSHIBA wordmark sits across the upper back of the current retail product photos (Goldwin Online Store replica RG325788, goldwin.co.jp/ap/item/i/m/RG325788, back view checked 2026-10-04).

source.name: Japan Rugby Football Union: 日本代表トップパートナー、オフィシャルパートナー、オフィシャルスポンサー、オフィシャルサポーター決定のお知らせ (Top partner, official partners, official sponsors and official supporters decided)
source.quote: 株式会社 東芝 株式会社三井住友銀行 セコム株式会社
source.note: JRFU announcement naming Sumitomo Mitsui Bank (SMBC) a men's Japan national team official partner from FY2020; still listed on the live JRFU sponsor page (checked 2026-10-04), and SMBC's own rugby site (smbc.co.jp/sponsorship/rugby/) says 'SMBCはラグビー男子日本代表のオフィシャルパートナーとして応援していきます' (page is Shift-JIS, so scripts can't verify the quote). The official launch-day promo image (JRFU 2025-06-22, https://rugby-japan.s3.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/image/article/199397_1000x1250.jpg) shows a dark patch with a white serif wordmark on the shorts hem of the front player - partially turned away, consistent with SMBC's wordmark - and the Japan crest on the other leg; no other commercial mark on the shorts.

source.name: Japan Rugby Football Union: ラグビー日本代表ジャージー新デザインを発表 ～ホームジャージーのデザインテーマは歌舞伎～ (Japan national team jersey new design announced - home theme kabuki)
source.quote: ラグビー日本代表のオフィシャルジャージーは、男女日本代表オフィシャルパートナーで「Canterbury」ブランドを展開する株式会社ゴールドウイン（代表取締役社長：渡辺貴生、東京都港区）によってデザイン製作されました
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. English: 'The Japan national teams' official jersey is designed and manufactured by Goldwin Inc., the company that develops the Canterbury brand and is an official partner of both national teams.' Canterbury has supported the national team since 1997 (Sposuru, 2023-08-08). On the shirt, the Canterbury CCC logo sits on the wearer's right chest of the official launch photo and current retail product photos (goldwin.co.jp/ap/item/i/m/RG325788, checked 2026-10-04); the sakura crest is on the left chest and a Japanese flag patch on the left sleeve - no other commercial marks on the sleeves, and the back below the TOSHIBA wordmark is plain.

summary: Lipovitan D (Taisho Pharmaceutical) across the front chest, TOSHIBA across the upper back and an SMBC patch on the shorts of the white Canterbury home shirt, with Canterbury as kit maker. The kabuki-themed design launched on 2025-06-22 and is unchanged into 2026/27; the sleeves carry only a Japan flag patch. SECOM, the other men's official partner, shows no logo on the match jersey in the official photos.
